newsitem.title: CHINA: Nortel's China investment to hit $150 mln.
newsitem.headline: Nortel's China investment to hit $150 mln.

text.p: Northern Telecom Ltd's investment in China is expected to reach $150 million by the end of 1998, a company official said on Wednesday.
The company, which entered China in 1972, had set up seven joint venture companies and three study centres in China, the official said.

Its biggest joint venture was Guangdong-Nortel Telecommunications in the southern province of Guangdong, with a production capacity of three million telephone lines of Nortel's advanced DMS switching system each year, she said.
Others were in Beijing, Shanghai, the western city of Xi'an, the northeastern city of Shenyang and southern Shenzhen, she said but gave no further details.
